rice.soil_preference: Heavy clay loam or alluvial soils capable of holding standing water.
rice.key_nutrients: High N (80-120 kg/ha), moderate P and K

maize.soil_preference: Well-drained fertile loamy soils rich in organic matter.
maize.key_nutrients: High N and P demands during vegetative and silking stages

chickpea.soil_preference: Well-drained light to medium textured loams or black cotton soils.
chickpea.water_demand: Low to Moderate (40 - 90 mm), very sensitive to waterlogging
chickpea.key_nutrients: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen; high requirement for Phosphorus

kidneybeans.soil_preference: Rich, well-aerated sandy loam with excellent organic drainage.
kidneybeans.key_nutrients: Moderate N and high Potassium requirement

pigeonpeas.soil_preference: Deep sandy loam to clay loams with good internal percolation.
pigeonpeas.key_nutrients: Deep tap root fixes nitrogen and recycles deep subsoil phosphorus

mothbeans.soil_preference: Light sandy and marginal dryland soils.
mothbeans.water_demand: Very Low (30 - 70 mm); highly drought resistant
mothbeans.key_nutrients: Requires minimal nitrogen, high drought resilience

blackgram.soil_preference: Heavy clay to loamy black soils.
blackgram.key_nutrients: Nitrogen fixer, responsive to basal Phosphorus application

lentil.soil_preference: Loam to clay loam soils with balanced moisture retention.
lentil.key_nutrients: Low N demand, responsive to zinc and phosphorus

pomegranate.soil_preference: Deep loamy or sandy loam with excellent internal drainage.
pomegranate.key_nutrients: High demand for balanced N-P-K plus Boron and Calcium

banana.soil_preference: Deep, loose, fertile alluvial soils with high organic matter.

mango.soil_preference: Deep alluvial, well-drained loam without hardpan.
mango.key_nutrients: Requires balanced N-P-K with dry period preceding bloom

grapes.soil_preference: Sandy loam to gravelly well-drained soils.
grapes.water_demand: Moderate (60 - 80 mm with dry ripening stage)
grapes.key_nutrients: High Potassium demand for sugar translocating into berries

watermelon.soil_preference: Sandy to sandy loam soils along riverbeds with good warmth.
watermelon.water_demand: Low to Moderate (40 - 60 mm with high irrigation control)

muskmelon.water_demand: Low (20 - 40 mm with controlled sub-surface moisture)
muskmelon.key_nutrients: Sensitive to waterlogging, needs balanced potassium for sweetness

apple.soil_preference: Deep, well-aerated loamy soils on gentle hill slopes.
apple.key_nutrients: High Potassium and Phosphorus, sensitive to Calcium deficiency

orange.soil_preference: Light loam to medium clay loam with unobstructed drainage.
orange.key_nutrients: Demands nitrogen, potassium, and micronutrients (Zinc, Iron)

papaya.soil_preference: Rich alluvial or loamy soils with flawless drainage (cannot stand stagnant water for 24h).
papaya.key_nutrients: Demands heavy organic matter, nitrogen, and continuous potassium

coconut.soil_preference: Coastal sandy loams, alluvial, and red sandy soils.
coconut.water_demand: High (130 - 250 mm with high groundwater table)
coconut.key_nutrients: High chlorine and potassium requirements for osmotic balance

cotton.soil_preference: Deep black cotton soils (vertisols) with high water-holding capacity.
cotton.key_nutrients: High nitrogen and potassium for boll retention and lint quality

jute.soil_preference: New alluvial soils, silt loams in floodplains.
jute.key_nutrients: High nitrogen for vegetative fiber elongation

coffee.soil_preference: Rich volcanic loam or forest soils with high organic humus and good drainage.
coffee.water_demand: High (140 - 220 mm, interspersed with dry spell for blossom trigger)
coffee.key_nutrients: High Potassium, balanced Nitrogen, and organic shade leaf mulch
